identity.title: List of How I Became a Pokémon Card volumes

source.sourceCategory: Category:How I Became a Pokémon Card volumes

leadText:
This is a list of volumes of the How I Became a Pokémon Card manga. There are six volumes in total. The How I Became a Pokémon Card manga has never been officially translated into English.

 

 

 
 

it:Elenco dei volumi di Pokémon Card Ni Natta Wake
